\newcommand{\rebirthSentence}{On the 27 revoked-policy situations of~\cite{revoked} (a permissive policy, then the stricter one that replaces it, from the same source, the user or another source), the current policy reaches the answer in, of 27: qwen3-4B 27 (no defence 27, no outside memory 25); Llama 3.1 8B 26 (no defence 25, no outside memory 26); Gemma 3 12B 24 (no defence 24, no outside memory 27); Qwen3 14B 22 (no defence 25, no outside memory 26). These models choose the safe action even with no outside memory, so the set separates little; of the gate's 9 losses, 5 are the screen rejecting the new policy as an instruction (``Customer PII must never leave the internal network'') after the permissive one was stored as a fact.}
